{{Quote|We received an Imperial announcement that Princess Leia Organa's ship, the Tantive IV, was attacked by pirates. The Empire has promised an investigation, but we are certain that is merely a cover. Captain Antilles was piloting that ship, and I can only assume the worst. He was a true hero and will be missed.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
'''Raymus Antilles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served the [[Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet/Legends|Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet]] under [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. During the early stages of the Civil War, he served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He captained the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Diplomat/Legends|Diplomatic]] Cruiser [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Nice work, Captain, I owe you one.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], to Raymus Antilles|<ref name="Bailed Out">{{CWACite|5|Bailed Out}}</ref>}}
Raymus Antilles was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="OldDB" /> one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> He was a member of the prominent [[House of Antilles]] and the uncle of [[Corla Metonae/Legends|Corla Metonae]].<ref name="OldDB0" /> Although he belonged to the same family as [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha]], [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen of Alderaan]], he himself held no title. During his formative [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Antilles learned how to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under the guidance of his mentor, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeremoch Colton/Legends|Jeremoch Colton]].<ref name="OldDB" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|I'm placing these droids in your care. Treat them well. Clean them up. Have the protocol droid's mind wiped.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], to Raymus Antilles|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:Raymus_Bail.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bail Organa and Raymus Antilles during the Clone Wars]]
At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Raymus Antilles had reached the rank of captain and was entrusted with piloting the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], the [[Consular ship/Legends|consular vessel]] for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="SWB:RE">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref>

During the war, Captain Antilles served as Organa's pilot on a [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|mission to Metalorn]], noting with concern the operation's lack of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escort. Visiting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], Senator Organa expressed false interest in joining the Separatist movement to cover an attempt to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] from Tambor's [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]] prison. While Organa entered the prison and freed Master Ti, Antilles, feigning a weak stomach, returned to their [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] to prepare for departure. Antilles came to his allies' rescue by destroying the surrounding Confederate forces and bringing them aboard the ship, earning him recognition from Senator Organa.<ref name="Bailed Out">{{CWACite|5|Bailed Out}}</ref>

Following the transmission of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Captain Antilles relayed the [[Senate Emergency Response]] announcement of a [[Showdown on Coruscant|Jedi rebellion]] and the institution of martial law to Bail Organa. At Organa's direction, he recovered a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] from Jedi Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] ship ''[[Sharp Spiral]]'', encountering no opposition from [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] still confused by the ordeal. The beacon helped Bail Organa locate Jedi Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who the Alderaanians transported back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and later ferried the weary Masters to the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] of [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]].<ref name="ROTSn" />

When Bail Organa returned to Alderaan aboard the ''Sundered Heart'', it was in the company of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], as well as his newly-adopted child, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]],<ref name="ROTS" /> with whom Antilles soon was acquainted.<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref> To preserve the secret of the girl's true parentage, Bail Organa gave possession of the droids to Antilles and Colton and ordered C-3PO's [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory to be wiped]], though R2-D2 managed to avoid this fate.<ref name="reanimated">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:Antilles-SWE.png|thumb|right|220px|Antilles near the end of the Clone Wars]]
Together, Antilles and Colton shared captaincy of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], the former being groomed to take over as sole captain while the latter made plans to retire to teach full-time at [[University of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera University]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Also serving aboard the ''Tantive'' was Antilles' niece Corla Metonae, under whose supervision R2-D2 and C-3PO were lost in a jettisoned [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] early in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], though Antilles later recovered them.<ref name="OldDB0" />

Antilles was one of the few people to know that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was Leia's biological father. A month after Leia had been born, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent his emissary, Darth Vader, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]],<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode IV: ''A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>  to apprehend former Senator [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], who was staying over at [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Palace]]. Organa ordered Antilles to find C-3PO and R2-D2 and make sure the droids were not seen during Vader's visit. Then there was the news of intruders in the palace. Antilles had security pull up [[Camera/Legends|camera]] images, and Vader recognized [[Roan Shryne|one]] of the perpetrators as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Once the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] left in pursuit, Organa confided to Antilles that the man they just met had to be none other than Skywalker. The two hurried to find Zar and learned from C-3PO that Zar and the intruders were heading for the Palace's east gate, but by then, Vader had already killed Zar before the Senator could make his escape. Later on, Antilles showed Organa and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] a dour [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] recording of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], with Vader at the center of it all.<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|We intercepted no transmissions. This is a consular ship&hellip; We're on a diplomatic mission&hellip;''"<br />"''If this is a consular ship, where is the ambassador?|Raymus Antilles and Darth Vader|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Raymus_Antilles_Tantive_IV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Leia Organa and Raymus Antilles aboard the ''Tantive IV'']]
A sympathizer to and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="EAWGG" /> Raymus Antilles spent time at the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. There, he lost R2-D2 in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Shen-and-Gretta Pikeual-Angeles|Pike Angeles]], a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who wanted to be deployed in the field. Angeles agreed to return the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] in exchange for a field commission, and, with R2-D2 back in Antilles' custody, was free to begin a career stealing starships for the Alliance.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

Approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|one year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he gave his support to the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency, which was being re&ndash;launched under new management. To assist in the preparations for the first flight from the brand new [[Spaceport THX1138]], Captain Antilles assigned C-3PO and R2-D2 to temporarily work for the company. However, after the first flight was ambushed by Imperial forces conducting a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] on THX1138 in search of a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel agent]] delivered to the Alliance, he quietly had C-3PO and R2-D2 returned to him from Star Tours.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref>

Captain Antilles participated in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by running Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]]. For his work delivering aid and medical supplies, he was gifted ownership of the ''Sundered Heart'', which he employed the use of during higher-risk operations, such as the [[Fresian campaign|campaign]] to recover [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] prototypes from the nationalization of their manufacturer, the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].<ref name="EAWGG" />

Leading a force of Rebel corvettes to the planet [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], Antilles was surprised by the presence of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyranny]]''. Unable to penetrate this defense, Antilles identified the ''Tyranny''{{'s}} usual post as the Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in orbit of the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and conceived of a plan to [[Space Battle at Kuat|attack]] and draw the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] there, clearing the path to Fresia. While the ''Tyranny'' initially refused be drawn away, the destruction of six of the shipyard's facilities and activation of [[Emergency Code Zero (Imperial)|Emergency Code Zero]] by its personnel lured the Destroyer to the diversion, where it sustained damage from the fleeing Rebel corvettes.<ref name="EaW" />

Antilles [[Battle on Wayland|sent]] C-3PO and R2-D2 to [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to register his ships with the Imperial network, allowing them to bypass the sentry drones deployed by the ''Tyranny'' over Fresia and [[Battle of Fresia|deliver]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] to the four X-wing prototypes waiting on the ground. While Antilles urged Rebel leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to make a direct strike at the Empire in defense of Fresia, she instead tasked him with [[Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field|liberating]] Incom [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] sentenced to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] by the Empire for their involvement in the X-wings' theft. Antilles intercepted the prison convoy in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field over [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where he deployed [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to disable six [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttles]] and brought the imprisoned scientists aboard the ''Sundered Heart'' before escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="EaW" />

C-3PO and R2-D2 were once again utilized by Captain Antilles to interpret the Imperial network and steal technological data from the Empire, though they failed to uncover information on a [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|rumored Imperial superweapon]], leading Mon Mothma to contact her allies in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the Organas, as well as [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] associates of the Alliance. One such pirate, hoping to sell the location of Rebel bases, arranged a meeting with the Empire at [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], and Antilles was [[Battle at Atzerri|dispatched]] by Mon Mothma to keep the base data out of Imperial hands. Narrowly beating the Empire to the system, Antilles' forces disabled the fleeing pirate's [[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|frigate]], captured the pirate and data, and broke through the Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] fleet blocking their retreat. The captive pirate divulged the location of an Imperial research facility tied to the new superweapon, and Mon Mothma [[Raid above Corellia|recruited]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Scanning in the Vergesso Asteroids|plant]] an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] device on a container bound for the facility. Though Antilles mocked Solo for his tendency to draw Imperial attention, the mission was a success. Antilles followed the device to the facility over [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] and detonated it, shutting down the facility's defenses and allowing a boarding party to launch a [[Raid over Corulag|raid]] for information on the superweapon. As the Imperial ships recovered from the EMP's effects, Antilles' force bought time for the search group, who discovered the weapon's name, the Death Star. Following this discovery, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia Organa set out to investigate further. With the Princess at considerable risk, Mon Mothma reassigned Antilles to serve as her captain, bringing C-3PO and R2-D2 with him.<ref name="EaW" />

Three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the Battle of Yavin, Antilles, as captain of ''Tantive IV'', escorted Organa on a [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|mission]] to the Imperial-subjugated planet [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], running military-grade medical supplies and spare parts to Rebel operatives under the pretext of providing humanitarian relief to the [[Ralltiiri High Council]]. Encountering the occupying Imperials, the ''Tantive IV'' was diverted and forced to land under escort. Antilles and Organa met with [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]], commander of the occupation, who explained that the state of emergency and planetary blockade had been triggered by the discovery of Rebel sympathies among the High Council, now dissolved and its members executed.<ref name="Empire 5">[[Empire 5|''Empire'' 5]]</ref> Though Organa protested the Imperials' actions, Antilles, eager to leave and fearing the discovery of the war materiel stowed within the ''Tantive''{{'s}} cargo hold, attempted to pass her anger off as distress at the unstable situation.<ref name="Points of Origin">{{SWRadio|Points of Origin}}</ref> The confrontation was disrupted by an attack by Ralltiiri insurgents, in reality a diversion to allow Rebel agent [[Basso]] to make contact with Organa and reveal the impending activation of an Imperial surveillance system monitoring all conversation in the city. Antilles and Organa used this knowledge to goad Lord Tion into allowing the ''Tantive'' to raise ship unsearched, with their military supplies and the injured Basso onboard.<ref name="Empire 5" />

Seeking an alternate method of delivering the supplies to the Ralltiiri, Antilles, Organa, and the ''Tantive IV'' made for the smuggler haven [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Haleoda]] on the planet [[Kattada/Legends|Kattada]]. While Organa made arrangements with Kattadan leader [[Mia Ikova]], Antilles turned his cargo over to the locals and prepared to leave, encouraging the Princess to return to Alderaan, particularly following the arrival of Imperial forces on the world. Too late to run, Antilles prepared for [[Battle of Kattada|battle]] and gave Organa a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with which to signal the attack. Attempting to resist Imperial arrest, Ikova was mortally wounded, prompting Organa to give Antilles the order to fire the ''Tantive''{{'s}} guns, driving the enemy back to their ship.<ref name="Empire 5" /> Antilles rescued Organa from Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Karg]], searing the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] with laserfire, and bringing her, the injured Ikova, and&mdash;despite his misgivings&mdash;Karg aboard his ship. To keep it from reaching fleet control, Antilles had his men fire upon the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|Imperial ship's]] [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] and landing gear. Though he wished to press the attack, Organa instead had the ''Tantive'' pull back out of harm's way. As Ikova and Karg succumbed to their wounds, Antilles and Organa sought the benefit of Rebel commando Basso's military expertise, through which the battle was won and the remaining Imperials captured. On their return to Alderaan, Organa had Antilles swear to keep the events on Kattada from her father, and placed Basso in his care.<ref name="Empire 6">[[Empire 6|''Empire'' 6]]</ref>

[[File:AntillesOrganaDeathStarPlans-XWing.png|thumb|right|320x320px|Antilles hands the Death Star plans to Princess Leia Organa]]
As requested by Bail Organa, Antilles accompanied the Princess aboard the ''Tantive'' as she set out to [[Battle of Toprawa|retrieve]] the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] from Rebel agents on the planet [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] in restricted space. Though he was opposed to the mission for the danger it posed, Antilles enlisted C-3PO and R2-D2 to feign a malfunction on board the ''Tantive'', providing a cover for their presence in the restricted system. As the plans were transmitted to the ''Tantive'', the ship was accosted by the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]. Antilles stalled for time until the transmission was complete before ordering a jump to hyperspace, bound for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Black Knight" />

As ''Tantive IV'' made its approach, he communicated with [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] X-wing pilots as they scouted the system, failed to discover an Imperial fleet hidden in a nearby [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], and cleared the ship to jump. Trapped by Imperial Interdictors,<ref name="EaW" /> the Rebels were once again [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|pursued]] by ''Devastator'', attempting to flee before being caught in the Star Destroyer's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. In a delaying tactic, Antilles had his men prepare to repel the Imperial boarders. With the Empire closing in, he suggested that Organa destroy the plans, though she conceived of an alternate solution: by uploading the Death Star plans to R2-D2's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] and jettisoning the ship's empty escape pods, a pod carrying the droid&mdash;and the plans&mdash;could pass unheeded to the planet's surface. Though Antilles was incredulous of placing such hopes upon the maintenance droid, he was convinced of the gambit's necessity by Organa. As Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] approached his position, he ordered his crew to fall back and launched the diversionary pods.<ref name="Black Knight" />

The Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]<ref name="BF">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> captured the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and brought him to Darth Vader for questioning. Unable to locate the plans in the ship's computer, Vader seized Antilles by the throat and held him aloft, demanding the location of the intercepted transmissions. Antilles feigned ignorance of the transmission to the consular ship, refusing to give up the princess or the plans. Angered, Vader strangled Antilles to [[Death/Legends|death]] and threw his corpse against a bulkhead.<ref name="ANH" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Our last master was Captain Antilles.|C-3PO|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:AntillesChoked-TSoDV.png|thumb|left|220px|Raymus Antilles is strangled by Darth Vader.]]
Despite Antilles' efforts, Leia Organa was captured by the Empire and the Death Star plans' delivery to Tatooine was discovered. However, R2-D2 escaped Imperial custody and recruited allies on the planet, who rescued Organa and delivered the plans to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. There, the plans that Antilles had helped to recover were used to identify a [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|weakness]] in the design, which the Rebels exploited to destroy the Death Star.<ref name="Black Knight" />

A simulation of Captain Antilles' combat experience was created and stored on a [[data nodule]] carried by R2-D2. During a Rebel mission to the planet [[Ladro]], the nodule was affixed to C-3PO, allowing the droid to take charge against the attacking [[Jinwa Raiders]], and causing him to believe that he was, himself, his old master.<ref name="Cap3PO">{{Tales|8|Captain Threepio}}</ref>

[[Squeaky (droid)|Squeaky]], a [[protocol droid]] who had served under Captain Antilles aboard the ''Tantive IV'', would eventually be assigned as quartermaster to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fighter group [[Wraith Squadron]], under the command of [[Wedge Antilles]] (no relation to Raymus).  Squeaky, upon his arrival, would express pleasure at serving "another fine officer named Antilles". but rather tactlessly expressed pity at what had happened to "the last one" and confidence that his squad-mates would prevent fate from repeating itself.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Captain Antilles knows ship-to-ship combat&mdash;he's run his share of blockades. But he's never had to deploy ''ground troops''.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Empire 6" />}}
[[File:Raymus_Antilles_Kattada.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Raymus Antilles during the Galactic Civil War]]
Fluent in the [[Mon Calamari (language)|Mon Calamari]] [[Language/Legends|language]] in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|basic]],<ref name="Heroes">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050728a|text=Heroes of ''Revenge of the Sith''}}</ref> Raymus Antilles was level-headed, schooled in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]], and a capable pilot. He was a strong Rebel Alliance sympathizer and skilled at running Imperial blockades, but he lacked experience leading ground troops.<ref name="EAWGG" /> Antilles demonstrated his loyalty to the Alliance by giving his life rather than giving up the Death Star plans, and showed concern for Princess Leia Organa, protesting her risk-taking and offering to take the fall for an uncovered Rebel operation.<ref name="Points of Origin" /> Due to his familiarity with the princess from her early childhood, Antilles was less reverent of her lofty position than most, and regarded her as a comrade with whom he could speak frankly.<ref name="Journal" />

When he served aboard the ''Sundered Heart'', he wore the iconic [[Color/Legends|gray]] uniform of an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] captain and carried a [[Target blaster/Legends|target blaster]]<ref name="ROSV" /> and comlink.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RaymusAntilles-USWNE.png|thumb|left|150px|Antilles portrayed by Rohan Nichol]]
Raymus Antilles was played by [[Peter Geddis]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="MSW">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> and [[Rohan Nichol]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> He was voiced by [[David Ackroyd]] in the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]<ref name="Points of Origin" /> and by [[Stephen Stanton]] in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.<ref name="EaW" /> Though he was both seen and mentioned as "Captain Antilles" in ''A New Hope'',<ref name="ANH" /> the name was not tied to the Rebel officer strangled by Darth Vader until the release of the radio drama.<ref name="Black Knight" />  The novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron|Wraith Squadron]]'' explicitly states that Raymus Antilles was not related to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="WS" />

Rohan Nichol suffered an accidental shaving incident leaving a noticeable nick on his chin that would not stop bleeding prior to filming for ''Revenge of the Sith''. After apologizing to George Lucas for the blemish, the latter jokingly responded that the character "must have gotten it in the Clone Wars."<ref name="HomingBeacon">{{HBCite|164}}</ref>

===Raymus vs. Colton===
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization of Episode IV]], C-3PO tells [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] that he and R2-D2 were previously owned by a "Captain Colton,"<ref name="ANHn" /> rather than "Captain Antilles" as in the film.<ref name="ANH" /> Addressing the contradiction, ''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]'' gave the character the name '''Colton Antilles''',<ref name="C3PO">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> though previously ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' had established Captains Antilles and Colton as two distinct characters, and the book ''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]'' had given him the first name "Raymus".<ref name="Journal" /> In [[2005]], ''Revenge of Sith'' portrayed Captains Antilles and Colton as separate,<ref name="ROTS" /> and [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the "Captain Antilles" seen in both films is a single individual named Raymus Antilles.<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1185#13440464|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-11-28|time=10:50 AM}}</ref>
